title: [LOGGED OUT] Header "Loyalty shop" scrolls to the Loyalty shop and its offer cards

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store and wait until loaded.
steps.saw: Store page loaded, title LUDUS - Merge Battle Arena PvP Web Shop.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner was in the page; clicked Dismiss.
Clicked the header link; page scrolled to the Loyalty shop.

steps.text: Wait 2 seconds until the page stops scrolling.
Is the "Loyalty shop" heading visible on the screen?
steps.saw: Heading "Loyalty shop" on a pink ribbon visible at top of screen just under the tab bar.

steps.text: Is "Loyalty shop" shown in yellow in the header?
steps.saw: Header item text colour rgb(249, 223, 66) (yellow); other items white.

steps.text: Does each Loyalty shop card show a name, an amount, a line starting with "Available" and a green button with a point price?
steps.saw: All 12 cards (Astral hero ... Handful of dice) show name, amount, an "Available weekly: x/y" line and a green button with a point price (1100, 550, 750, 550, 550, 300, 160, 650, 180, 240, 350, 160).
